transcript.text: hoover washer drier showing EO3 wont drain, ive done the filter its clean. H3DS4965DACE. pump just buzzes. do i need a new pump??

A buzzing sound usually means the pump motor is trying to run but something is stopping it. The most likely cause is that a small object (like a coin, button, or hair tie) has fallen past the filter and is jamming the pump impeller inside. It could also be that the pump motor itself has failed electrically. To tell them apart: please unplug the machine for safety, reach into the filter housing, and try to turn the small plastic fan blades at the back with your finger. If it is stuck or hard to turn, you likely just need to clear the blockage; if it spins freely but still buzzes when running, the pump motor itself has probably failed.
ok did that with power off. impeller spins freely, no resistance at all, feels like its not connected to anything. torch shows one fin looks snapped

[Heading: Likely cause: drain pump (jammed or failed)]
That suggests the issue. The snapped fin and free-spinning impeller mean the plastic coupling inside the pump has broken, so the motor spins but cannot move the water. You will need to replace the entire drain pump assembly; cleaning or repairing the impeller is not possible as it is integral to the unit. Since this involves disconnecting electrical wiring and plumbing behind the panel, I recommend contacting a qualified engineer or sourcing the correct replacement part for your Hoover model H3DS4965DACE from an authorised supplier.

ok but before i order one, can you confirm its the pump? coil reads about 170 ohms on my meter. is the pump a separate part from the filter housing on this one or do i need the whole thing? happy to fit it myself

[Heading: Likely cause: drain pump (jammed or failed)]
Yes, the 170 ohms reading suggests the motor windings are intact and not burnt out. On this type of washer-dryer, the drain pump is a separate unit that mounts to or sits within the filter housing area, so you typically replace just the pump assembly itself rather than the entire plastic sump/filter housing. Since you are happy to fit it yourself, order the replacement drain pump for your model and disconnect the power before swapping it out.
